_comment: Curated editorial dispatches — the periodical voice, hand-written. Merged with the auto-detected feed.json at render time (client + RSS) so the daily refresh never clobbers these. Shape mirrors feed.json entries: {ts, instrument, kind, text}. Use instrument:'atlas' + kind:'dispatch' for editorial notes. Newest first by ts.

entries.text: New: a public changelog + RSS feed — every cloud change we detect, dated and sourced. Subscribe at /feed.xml.
New instrument: the Constellation — a visual, navigable map of every instrument at /atlas/.
Two new instruments: the Observability Matrix (cloud-native + managed) and Observability Stacks (self-hosted OSS).
New: a Testing & Integration toolbox — floci, Testcontainers, Terratest, BATS, Mockoon and Pact.
